Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea: How to watch, TV channel, live stream, NOW TV, team news and score prediction
Sky customers can watch Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea on Sky Sports from 7pm or via the Sky Sports app; non-Sky customers can stream the game with a NOW Day or Month pass; kick-off at the City Ground is 8pm on Friday November 27
Friday 27 November 2026 09:30, UK
Nottingham Forest host Chelsea at the City Ground in a Friday Night Football Premier League clash on November 27, live on Sky Sports.
Xabi Alonso's Chelsea side have lost three of their last four Premier League games and have plenty of questions to answer, especially after a bruising 4-1 home defeat to Leeds United last time out.
Oliver Glasner's Nottingham Forest side are 17th in the table and outside the relegation zone on goal difference. But in their last home game they emphatically beat Manchester City 3-1, thanks to two goals from former Chelsea striker Liam Delap.

When is Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea?
Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea in the Premier League takes place on Friday November 27 at the City Ground. Kick-off is 8pm UK and Ireland time.

Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea odds and score prediction
Sky Sports' Lewis Jones...
I'm not for jumping off the Nottingham Forest bandwagon just yet.
Forest have taken just four points from their last seven Premier League games - no team has taken fewer - yet they sit sixth in the expected points table for the season.
There is a significant disconnect between performance levels and results, something that usually corrects itself over time. I'm still a firm believer that Oliver Glasner will get this talented group of players motoring up the Premier League table.
And I'm struggling to see why Chelsea should command quite so much respect from the markets.
Of the ever-present Premier League teams in 2026, only one has lost more games than Chelsea (14) and only one has conceded more goals (51).
Where has Xabi Alonso's defensive magic gone?
His invincible Bayer Leverkusen side conceded just 24 league goals across their entire title-winning campaign in 2023/24. Chelsea have shipped 20 in 11 games this season alone. There is a softness to this Chelsea team when opponents turn up the intensity and attack them directly.
Just two clean sheets in their last 27 Premier League games tells a sorry tale.
Forest have the attacking weaponry to expose those defensive deficiencies.
The 29/20 with Sky Bet for a home win makes lots of sense.
SCORE PREDICTION: 2-1
Nottingham Forest v Chelsea team news
Moises Caicedo has trained this week after coming off injured in the first half against Leeds United.
Chelsea will be without Joao Pedro, Maxence Lacroix, Jorrell Hato and Reece James.
Wesley Fofana, who this week apologised for conducting an unauthorised interview, will be available for selection.
Forest, meanwhile, will have midfielder Xaver Schlager and winger Callum Hudson-Odoi available.
They will be without midfielder Nicolas Dominguez and defender Nicolo Savona.

נוטינגהאם פורסט תארח את צ'לסי במגרשה הביתי למשחק מרכזי בפרמייר ליג. צ'לסי, בניהולו של המאמן צ'אבי אלונסו, מגיעה להתמודדות לאחר תקופה לא פשוטה הכוללת הפסדים רבים ומספר ספיגות גבוה, המעידים על חולשה הגנתית לעומת היכולת המרשימה שהציג אלונסו בעבר בבאייר לברקוזן. מנגד, נוטינגהאם פורסט אמנם מדורגת בחלק התחתון של הטבלה, אך היא מגיעה לאחר ניצחון מרשים בבית על מנצ'סטר סיטי ומציגה מגמת שיפור.

לקראת ההתמודדות, שתי הקבוצות נדרשות להתמודד עם חיסורים בסגל. צ'לסי תחסר מספר שחקנים משמעותיים ובהם ז'ואאו פדרו וריס ג'יימס, אך תוכל לשתף את ווסלי פופאנה. מנגד, נוטינגהאם פורסט תקבל בחזרה את חאבר שלאגר וקאלום האדסון-אודואי, אך לא תכלול בסגל את ניקולאס דומינגז וניקולו סבונה.
